races_in_feed: statewide (Governor and Lieutenant Governor), Congress, State Senate and House, ballot questions; not local offices
local: yes, for county-level detail and precincts: Allegheny (Clarity, https://results.enr.clarityelections.com/PA/Allegheny/), Philadelphia (https://vote.phila.gov/results/); Montgomery, Bucks and Delaware counties run their own results pages (not checked)
how_counted: Counties may not start processing mail ballots until 7 a.m. on Election Day, so mail counts arrive county by county; Election Day, mail and provisional votes are reported apart.
count_order: Election Day, Mail and Provisional by county (Reporting Center CSV).
vote_types: yes: every candidate's Election Day, Mail and Provisional votes, by county (the Reporting Center CSV columns 'Election Day Votes', 'Mail Votes', 'Provisional Votes'). Pennsylvania may not start processing mail ballots until 7 a.m. on Election Day, so mail counts arrive on a county-by-county schedule: valuable for the count-order predictor.

certify.body: the Pennsylvania Secretary of the Commonwealth
certify.rule: No completion deadline in the law (25 P.S. 3159); counties certify after the five-day recount window (3154(f)).
certify.local_rule: Unofficial returns by 5 p.m. on the Tuesday after (3154(f)).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

rehearsal: 105G@2024-11-05 (the 2024 general, election 105 type G; run_night.py replay --election pa=105G@2024-11-05)
terms: none stated on the API; the site is the Department's public returns
scout_plan: Live-readable. On the night, read GetElectionList once to find the 2026 General's id, then poll GetOfficeData for offices 3, 11, 12 and 13 every few minutes (four calls a round), and GetCountyBreak only for the races on the map that are open, to fill the county shading. Pull the Reporting Center CSV once an hour for the Election Day/Mail/Provisional split that feeds count order. Rehearse on election 105 (2024) in October. Local results are a handful of specials: take them from the county sites only where one is on the ballot, otherwise say Pennsylvania holds its local elections in odd years.
notes: The answers carry no precincts reporting; the pages show votes and counties without a precinct count.
County breakdowns: every statewide office on each change; congressional districts at most every 10 minutes; legislative districts never (district totals only), to keep requests few.
